claims.claim: Quintus Septimius Florens Tertullianus was born in Carthage around 155‑160 AD and died after 220 AD.
Tertullian wrote De idololatria (On Idolatry) in the early third century, after his Apology and before his treatise De Spectaculis.
The treatise was addressed to Christian believers living in a society saturated with pagan worship, offering guidance on how to avoid participation in idolatrous practices.
The work survives in the Latin manuscript tradition and is transmitted to modern readers through its inclusion in the Ante‑Nicene Fathers collection and online editions such as New Advent.
